messages:
alex: Quick poll — what's the weirdest internet/WFH hack you've actually tried to keep a stable connection? I'll start: I propped the router on top of a broom handle inside a closet for better line-of-sight. :joy:

mira: oh noooo broom-handle pro. I put my router in the freezer for 10 mins during a heatwave once. weirdly improved throughput for ~15 mins. :sweat_smile:

devon: microwave + baby monitor interference is real. had to change channels mid-call.

jin: ran a spare Cat5 through the attic and hooked it to a $5 switch. felt very illegal but 0 packet loss since.

sam: vote react poll — 🍞 for broom, 🧊 for freezer, 🧰 for attic cable, 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 for neighbor wifi freeload (just kidding)

linda: 🧊 from me. also made a DIY ring light from a lamp + baking parchment — looks chaotic but good for Zoom. pic: http://imgur.com/placeholder

devon: pro-tip if VPN drops, try `sudo systemctl restart NetworkManager` — sometimes fixes DNS without rebooting.

alex: @ops-bot can you share if there were any carrier blips today? my zoom died at 11:43.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Carrier performed a fiber handover at 2026-11-18T11:42:00Z. Observed outage window 11:41:58–11:47:20 UTC for Building 4. Average latency spiked to 120ms during event. Ticket INC-2026-498 opened and resolved. :white_check_mark:

mira: that explains it. my meeting dropped exactly then. thanks ops-bot.

jin: speedtest after the handover, fwiw:
```
Ping: 18 ms
Download: 210.45 Mbps
Upload: 18.02 Mbps
```

alex: freezer-router person pls explain setup details (temperature concerns?). :cold_face:

sam: once routed ethernet under the table with gaffer tape. looked like prehistoric fossils. 0 regrets.

linda: shoutout to @devon for loaning a spare switch last month :heart:

devon: anytime. also if channels overlap, `iw dev wlan0 scan` is useful to see neighbors.

mira: tallying votes: 🧊 3, 🍞 2, 🧰 1, 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 0 — freezer wins? should we put a short "weird WFH hacks" doc in #devex? :memo:

alex: yes please. I'll start a Notion with a few examples and safe tips (don't actually keep routers in food storage for long).

ops-bot: ops-bot: Note added to INC-2026-498: impact limited to Building 4, no data loss, follow-up with carrier scheduled.

jin: also quick PSA: kids sometimes learn to shout "deploy" and then everyone panics. mute button saves lives. :child:
